leaves.name: faltingsLemma1DVRPrint
leaves.doc: Faltings 1983, p. 350, Lemma 1 (page read by the reading desk): a generic-fibre homomorphism of semiabelian schemes with abelian generic fibres extends uniquely as a morphism. S = Spec O is normal and U is its dense generic open. The model hypotheses give extensions by actual torus group schemes on both residue-field fibres, by isSemiabelianModelO_imp_faltingsDefScheme. The specialization is faltingsLemma1DVRPrint_of_printed; faltingsLemma1DVR_iff_print proves equivalence to the homomorphism form.
leaves.flag: page read verbatim from the page image by the reading desk (p. 350, Definition and Lemma 1); rated by the reviewer, a third two-lens skeptic pass (print fidelity, Lean semantics) could not refute it. Re-route within a cited source: the paper is in the manuscript's bibliography (L11084-11086) and cited at L621 and L733, but for other results, not Lemma 1. Proved bridges: faltingsLemma1DVRPrint_of_printed, isSemiabelianModelO_imp_faltingsDefScheme, hasTorusExtensionScheme_of_hasTorusExtension, faltingsLemma1DVR_iff_print. Encoding: U is an open immersion (jO_genericOpen); the two fibres are base changes along jO and along the residue map (specDVR_points shows they exhaust Spec O)
